text: Two ICC Premier Partners sit at the top of chains that end with the Government of Dubai (Emirates, via the Dubai government's investment arm; DP World, whose ultimate owner the company states is the Government of Dubai). Human Rights Watch documented that in 2024 a UAE court sentenced 43 Emirati activists and dissidents to life imprisonment after a mass trial, and that the Federal Supreme Court upheld the convictions in March 2025.

source.name: Human Rights Watch: UAE: Unfair Mass Trial Convictions Upheld
source.note: Replaced dead link https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/07/23/uae-43-life-sentences-flagrant-injustice (404; original July 2024 release 'UAE: 43 Life Sentences in Flagrant Injustice' no longer on hrw.org). This March 2025 release covers both facts: it recounts the July 10, 2024 sentencing (43 defendants to life in prison) and reports the State Security Chamber of the Federal Supreme Court upholding the convictions on March 4, 2025.
